regime_context: China A-shares rank Gold Miners first and AI Compute & Optics second, but the backtest verdict is blunt: the momentum rank is a focus lens (rank-IC ~0) and the absolute-trend gate did_NOT_hold on this market's history (gate_helps=false), so the one claimed edge failed here. Eligible set is narrow (8/22) and the tape is mean-reverting in several components — a low-conviction, humbling regime.
emerging_watch: Watch Gold Miners (rank 1, crowded=true, breadth 0.0, scorable=false) for a confirmed leadership handoff: it leads on score but has zero breadth and is crowded, so leadership is one-name-thin. I am watching for AI Compute & Optics to close the score margin (currently 0.2 points, 515000.SS vs Gold) AND hold above Gold for 3 consecutive sessions — that combination would retire this watch as a confirmed handoff; otherwise Gold simply remains the crowded, unscorable incumbent.

theses.subject: AI Compute & Optics
theses.thesis: Rank #2 and the only top-3 scorable theme with a proxy ETF (515000.SS); eligible, above-trend score, and NOT crowded (crowding_z -0.17), so a trend-following lean without a crowding cap. Momentum rank is a focus lens, not alpha, and the trend gate has no drawdown edge here, so this is a modest conditional lean, not a prediction.
evidence: hurst_tag mean-revert — a caution on trend persistence, not a disqualifier
theses.dissent: hurst_tag mean-revert plus a detector whose absolute-trend gate did not reduce drawdown on this exact market means whipsaw risk is high; the top-ranked theme is Gold Miners, not this one, so leadership is contested.

falsifier.text: 515000.SS lags CSI 300 by 5% or more before the 20-day check-by date

theses.subject: Rare Earth & Magnets
theses.thesis: Rank #3, eligible, scorable (512400.SS), not crowded, with a durability_bar of 0.52 and mixed hurst. A cyclicals/resource theme just below the leaders in a tape where that category dominates ranks — treated as a conditional trend lean given the focus-lens caveat, not an alpha claim.
theses.dissent: Cross-sectional momentum rank carries roughly zero forward edge; this is a focus read only, and mixed hurst gives no trend-persistence signal to lean on.

falsifier.text: 512400.SS lags CSI 300 by 5% or more before the 20-day check-by date

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Rank #6 and eligible but flagged crowded=true with the highest crowding_z (2.12) in the scorable eligible set. Crowding is a size-down caution only — never a short — so the honest lean for a crowded, mixed-hurst theme with rank outside the top 5 is to avoid initiating, not to fade.
theses.dissent: High crowding can coexist with continued momentum in reflexive tapes, and crowding has no basket-level forward edge here, so avoiding may miss further gains.

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ outperforms CSI 300 on a relative basis before the 20-day check-by date
